augers_lineup_2026-11-17.jpg.note: For Fig. 5d (review of 17 Nov), replacing augers_lineup_2026-09-10.jpg. Eight capped augers in a staggered row, labels up, top to bottom: brown rice flour (auger 1), brown rice flour (auger 2), white rice flour, sodium alginate, calcium lactate, carboxymethyl cellulose, xanthan gum, sodium chloride (black tube). Seven powders, all food-safe surrogates. Original file as posted, 4032 x 3024; the only EXIF tags are orientation (upright), resolution and pixel size, so no location, date or camera. 'date' is the posting date; the date taken is not recorded.

solenoid_bracket_2026-11-17.jpg.author: swcharles (photo); ethanw-24 (design, issue #203)
solenoid_bracket_2026-11-17.jpg.note: For Fig. 3a, last image (review of 17 Nov). Ethan's solenoid bracket (#203; first version in Onshape 7 Nov): one printed base carrying a flexible snap-in clip for the auger and a mount for the solenoid, with no collar around the auger. Printed in blue, solenoid fitted. The solenoid's part-number label is legible at full size. Original file as posted, 4032 x 3024; EXIF has orientation, resolution and pixel size only. 'date' is the posting date.
